description:
Cast Moorland Rescuer by paying {5}{W}.
Moorland Rescuer enters the battlefield and triggers Molten Echoes, creating a token copy of Moorland Rescuer with haste.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the nontoken Moorland Rescuer.
The nontoken Moorland Rescuer dies, triggering itself.
In response, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the token Moorland Rescuer.
The token Moorland Rescuer dies, triggering itself, returning the nontoken Moorland Rescuer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Molten Echoes triggers again, creating a token copy of Moorland Rescuer with haste.
Resolve a Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the remaining Moorland Rescuer trigger, returning any number of creature cards with total power 4 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield and failing to exile the Moorland Rescuer which has left the graveyard.
Resolve the remaining Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
